change_summary: Consolidate separate research-only joint prop audit branches: preserve cross-snapshot team and settled-result all-copy quarantine plus 30-event descriptive CI, require independent model_mode, prevent overwritten report files, refuse duplicate frozen joint probabilities in either row order including malformed-first, and run explicit synthetic CI.
assumptions: Parent #366 is a research-only synthetic tester; a passing CI suite is not independent original player/odds/provider data verification.
Both #359 and #363 cover overlapping joint auditing files; their safeguards must be integrated rather than merged independently in conflicting order.
Deduplicating original joint probability records before numeric parsing is essential to eliminate invalid-first/valid-second first-row-wins bias.
Private output reports use create-only semantics, not crash-atomic publication; no historical or official betting records are touched.
agent_identity: ChatGPT GPT-6 independent SportsEdge joint-prop research integration lane

baseline.metric: integrated joint player-prop duplicate and cross-snapshot refusal integrity

evaluation.test_command: python -m unittest discover -s research/audit -p 'test_prop_joint*.py' -v && python research/audit/prop_joint_correlation.py --self-test

rollback.verification_command: python -m unittest discover -s research/audit -p 'test_prop_joint*.py' -v && python research/audit/prop_joint_correlation.py --self-test
